title: TreeStack — Structural Certificates for Stacking on Trees
headline: A Lean 4 proof of the corrected nontrivial-tree form of the Csernák–Soukup tree-stacking estimator conjecture.
description: For every finite tree $T$ with at least two vertices, this project proves $\operatorname{stack}(T)=\operatorname{estim}(T)$, the corrected nontrivial-tree form of the Csernák–Soukup estimator conjecture. The result is machine-checked end to end in Lean 4, with Palomar mechanical verification and automated review completed; public Palomar registration is pending. A standalone research article is present in the repository, but no arXiv submission or DOI exists yet.
verification: The Lean 4 formalisation machine-checks the main theorem end to end. Palomar mechanical verification and automated review passed for revision 4d4969703a9f0ca7a51cbe7edf0f0338cc95cafb; public registration is pending.
attribution: Original conjecture and estimator: Tamás Csernák and Lajos Soukup. Proof, Lean 4 formalisation, computational validation and research article: John Fairfax-Ball, with extensive AI assistance documented in the repository.
original_source: Tamás Csernák and Lajos Soukup, “Stacking and clearing in graph pebbling”, arXiv:2604.22341v1, Conjecture 10.3.
